whatToTestReadBack.whatsNew:
Build 2.0 (113) adds My Fighters, a private four-pose fighter library, creation consent, saved request recovery and downloaded fighter reuse. Test the retro game, battles, sharing, saved progress and the new library interface.

Live image generation is unavailable because the beta service has no configured provider key. Four-pose generation has not been verified with a live provider; automated tests use synthetic artwork. Existing typed custom fighters remain available.

Sign in with Apple, subscription association, cross-device restoration and account deletion need physical-device testing. Real account acceptance has not been verified by simulator fixtures. Downloaded artwork is intended to remain usable offline after a creation subscription ends.

Please report crashes, lost progress, unreadable controls, clipped fighters or unexpected costs. Public release remains gated on real account testing and a separately validated live image-generation pilot.

Visual review covers listed still captures and viewport positions; it does not establish continuous pacing, sustained physical memory/performance or all standalone exported files.
The application budget ledger is not an external provider billing cap. Production creation and public release remain unavailable.
Apple authorization-grant revocation, finite database-backup expiry and actual device/account acceptance remain public-release checks.
Internal TestFlight availability is verified; physical owner installation, live account acceptance, live image generation and public release remain unverified.
